gen-almendra-display-gf-voces: Ornate, storybook lettering that never seems to pinch shut up top. Voces, a sans-serif with lofty lowercase and stems nearly matching its hairlines, moves steadily through paragraphs beneath Almendra Display.
gen-archivo-black-gf-geist-mono: Archivo Black lands heavy, with generous room around every letter. Geist Mono, a monospace with pencil-line strokes and wide side gaps, does best when you nudge its size up a notch.
gen-archivo-black-gf-major-mono-display: A towering x-height fills the middle of every line in Archivo Black. Major Mono Display, a monospace drawn like neon tubing, then threads fine stitched lines of wide-set letters beneath that mass.
gen-archivo-black-gf-martian-mono: Heavy, low-contrast letters with a tall middle and plenty of breathing room give Archivo Black its urban punch. Martian Mono, a monospace, lets text tick along in loose, steady-barred rhythm.
gen-archivo-black-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono reads loose and magnified, its bowls left open on one side. Its strokes carry no shading at all, so paragraphs of this monospace unfold steadily beneath Archivo Black.
gen-audiowide-fs-chillax: Audiowide stamps out futuristic, tile-like letters with wide gaps between them. Chillax, a relaxed sans with looping, pen-lifted curves and a spaghetti-like line, lets paragraphs drift along loosely underneath.
gen-audiowide-fs-spline-sans: Uniform strokes with no thick-thin shift make Audiowide look cut from tiles. Spline Sans, with wide gaps at its curve ends and matching vertical and horizontal strokes, makes paragraphs feel open and easy going.
gen-audiowide-gf-aclonica: Futuristic and drawn-wire thin in feel, Audiowide stands over Aclonica, whose deep midsection and wide spacing stretch each line out. One is crisp and technical, the other mild and friendly.
gen-audiowide-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Oversized lowercase and a squeezed fit make the text feel tight and contemporary. Alumni Sans SC is the sans-serif that packs in text, while Audiowide is the one that fills a line with tiled, uniform strokes.
gen-audiowide-gf-anaheim: Anaheim moves quickly, a dense, friendly huddle of rounded, open-sided letters that the eye slides straight through. Audiowide earns its keep big and brief, with curves that never thin.
